# Central Storage & Warehouse

Central Storage & Warehouse is a Warehousing and Storage company. CSW: Cold Storage and Warehouse is a company that provides cold storage and warehouse services. They offer personalized service, technology, and quality assurance. They have multiple locations and prioritize customer satisfaction. Central Storage & Warehouse employs 72 people (+9.1% YoY, +6 people) and has an annual revenue of $17.3M, founded in 1947. Headquartered in Franksville, Wisconsin, United States, with offices in Eau Claire, Madison, Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin Rapids, and Caledonia. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

Central Storage & Warehouse (CSW) is the premier provider of temperature-controlled warehouse services in Wisconsin. Established in 1947, we build long term relationships by being responsive to customer needs with personalized service. As one of Wisconsin's largest providers of refrigerated and frozen public warehousing, we also have the locations, experience, and technical know-how to handle any project. Our knowledgeable staff and AIB SUPERIOR-rated facilities ensure top-notch food safety and product quality.

CENTRAL STORAGE SYSTEMS LIMITED is a Construction company. Central Storage Systems is one of the UK’s leading manufacturers of mezzanine floors and associated products. They offer tailored storage solutions, including custom-designed platforms and mezzanine flooring, to optimize warehouse, workshop, or factory space. CENTRAL STORAGE SYSTEMS LIMITED employs 7 people (+16.7% YoY, +1 person) and has an annual revenue of $26.8M, founded in 2002. Headquartered in United Kingdom, with an office in Kidderminster.

## About

ACentral Storage Systems Ltd specialises in the design, manufacture and installation of mezzanine floors and warehouse storage solutions across the UK.
